newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 7.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 7.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange's Composite Index ended down 7.30 points or 0.68 percent to 1,073.31. Second Board continued to draw interest, rising 2.21 points or 0.39 percent to 566.94.
* Wall Street closed on Friday for Independence Day holiday. On Thursday, closed up 100.43 points to 7,895.81 after tame employment report.
* Ringgit to be watched closely for any signs of Bank Negara intervention to stave off attacks on the currency.
Ringgit quoted at 2.5244/54 to a dollar at 1000 GMT on Friday against 2.5240/50 at Kuala Lumpur close on Thursday.

* As for the stock market, "I think most people think it's going to be sideways this week," said the head of research at a local firm. Investors have been focused more on speculative plays and ignoring blue chips.
* Malaysia's trade balance in May stood at 156.8 million ringgit surplus, acting Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said over the weekend. That compared to 2.12 billion ringgit deficit in April.
* Timber products maker Syarikat Binaan Budi Sawmill Bhd expected to list on Second Board at offer price of 3.10 ringgit a share.

* Malaysian Airline System Bhd has reorganised top management in bid to rejuvenate operations, the Star reported on Saturday. Newspaper says airline is creating three new positions for executive vice presidents, taking their total number to 11.
